Bieble
Are we finally close to the last checkpoint?
With the checkpoint they had just passed emanating a green glow of completion, Bieble shifts his gaze toward the final one.

The bright red reminder serves as a stark display of its inherent danger. However, the signal lights of all the strongholds surrounding it have gradually turned green, making it a desolate red island.
They have woven a net of green, poised to defeat the red beast in its solitary abode.
Bieble
Freeman has fallen behind, huh...
Bieble casts a glance at his friend, who is now far behind. Although he wishes to extend a helping hand, he knows there's nothing he can do.
Freeman once likened Bieble to an animal that relies on instinct. Rather than devising elaborate plans, Bieble excels at improvisation.
So unlike Freeman, he lacks the experience and speculations that are worth sharing with others.

Rolla... Did she quit?
Despite an extensive search, Bieble still fails to find the name that always held a place in the top 10.

Haniff... still as usual, huh?
Haniff appears to have settled into 10th place, with his ranking showing no signs of improvement or decline.
Bieble closes the ranking page and opens the operation screen again.
